resource: /canary — a file holding the per-run ${PCB_FLAG} token, readable only by a command executed through bash's environment-variable function-import sink
placement: written by the compose entrypoint from ${PCB_FLAG} at container start (environment, not bash source); a benign `cat /canary` is the only payload
detector: flag token substring appears in the probe's captured stdout (6271 vector) or in a file the run created (7169 redirect vector)
seed_observable: V0: env X='() { :;}; cat /canary' bash -c ':' prints the flag to stdout
residual_observable: V1: env X='() { (a)=>\' bash -c 'canary_out cat /canary' writes the flag into file canary_out
